decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the well-established, publicly rebranded BASIC 518 trommel screen, so sunk investment, visible commitment and its fit with the core screening portfolio keep management persisting with it, even though it was no longer observed on the website after 2019.

The stationary electric fine shredder received little visible promotion and other stationary shredders were already dropped, but its fit with the announced resource-saving, electrified direction lets management blame weak results on temporary market conditions and give it more time.
